blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House Dangerous Drugs Committee is set to probe the attempted smuggling of 521 kilograms of shabu (methamphetamine) valued at P3.5 billion intercepted in Laos bound for the Philippines, its chairman Las Pinas Rep. Mark Anthony Santos said on Wednesday. Santos said his panel summoned Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla and Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) chief Isagani Nerez to a preliminary briefing on Thursday. “The briefing will focus on verified facts, the status of ongoing investigations by concerned agencies, the basis for establishing any Philippine connection to the shipment, and measures to prevent the entry […]...
